ops.title: Audit HOME/XDG-derived paths under brew postinstall contexts (temp-HOME sandbox)
ops.description: Root-caused on the local machine (daemonkit investigation 8841b9c0): Homebrew runs formula postinstall under a sandboxed temp HOME, and daemonkit's $HOME-derived plist path made launchd refuse bootstraps with EPERM (fix in flight: passwd-based resolution). synckit's own config dir shares the exposure shape: hostregistry Config.Dir() resolves XDG_CONFIG_HOME then $HOME/.config (hostregistry/store.go:63-79), so a synckitd invoked from a brew postinstall (or any sandboxed-HOME context) would open a fresh empty services.db and state.json under the temp dir — silently operating on the wrong universe, writing plists to untrusted paths, and discarding its work with the temp dir. The fleet has only run synckitd install interactively over SSH so far (real HOME), so this has not bitten — audit whether any synckit formula postinstall (or future automation) invokes synckitd, and decide: passwd-based resolution like daemonkit, or a loud refusal when the resolved config dir is under a temp root.

ops.text: synckitd behaves correctly (or refuses loudly) when invoked with a sandboxed temp HOME, never writing durable state or plists to temp paths
